Bill.BriefDescription: Providing biodiesel and ethanol fuel mandates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing biodiesel and ethanol fuel mandates;amending RCW 19.112.010; adding new sections to chapter 19.112 RCW; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.112.010 and 1991 c 145 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: As used in this chapter: (1) "Biodiesel" means a mono alkyl ester of long chain fatty acidsderived from vegetable oils or animal fats for use in compressionignition engines and that meets the requirements of the Americansociety for testing and materials specification D6751, in effect as ofJanuary 1, 2004. (2) "Ethanol" means fuelgrade ethanol that meets the requirementsof the American society for testing and materials specification D4806,"Standard Specification for Denatured Fuel Ethanol for Blending withGasolines for Use as Automotive SparkIgnition Engine Fuel," in effectas of January 1, 2004. (3) "Motor fuel" means any liquid product used for the generationof power in an internal combustion engine used for the propulsion of a p. 1 SB 6487motor vehicle upon the highways of this state. Motor fuels containingethanol may be marketed if either (a) the base motor fuel meets theapplicable standards before the addition of the ethanol or (b) theresultant blend meets the applicable standards after the addition ofthe ethanol. (((2))) (4) "Director" means the director of agriculture.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.112 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All diesel fuel sold or offered for sale in the state for usein internal combustion engines must contain at least two percentbiodiesel fuel by volume, except as provided in subsection (2) of thissection. (2) The minimum biodiesel fuel content requirement does not applyto fuel used in the following equipment: (a) Motors located at anelectric generating plant regulated by the nuclear regulatorycommission, unless the commission has approved the use of biodieselfuel in motors at electric generating plants under its regulation; or(b) railroad locomotives.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.112 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) On and after July 1, 2006, and until July 1, 2007, at leastthirtyfive percent of all gasoline sold by each distributor for use inmotor vehicles in the state must contain ten percent ethanol by volume. (2) On and after July 1, 2007, and until July 1, 2008, at leastseventy percent of all gasoline sold by each distributor for use inmotor vehicles in the state must contain ten percent ethanol by volume. (3) On and after July 1, 2008, at least eightyfive percent of allgasoline sold by each distributor for use in motor vehicles in thestate must contain ten percent ethanol by volume.
